rca:flags.text: Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (30871 scans, 13760 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Niskin 13 (SA-219, ~99 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle +0.0251 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.019 PSU/m.
Niskin 13 (SA-219, ~99 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle +0.0243 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.017 PSU/m.
Autosal workbook header date is 2023-10-05 but the cast is on 2023-08-15; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
